summary: Ondas Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a prospectus supplement covering the resale of 4,001 shares of common stock by certain stockholders who acquired the shares in connection with the company's acquisition of World View Enterprises Inc. The shares were issued in a private transaction exempt under Regulation D, and the filing includes a legal opinion from Snell & Wilmer L.L.P. regarding the shares' legality. No price, premium, or terms of the underlying acquisition are provided. This is a routine administrative step to register shares for resale and does not constitute a new special situation event.
